tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang gsang thugs kyi phur gcig las: tshe 'gugs bzhugs: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo:

dkyil 'khor dbus su tshe yi 'brang rgyas bsham: g.yas g.yon du tshe chang dang tshe mda' bsham: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: bzlas shing mda' dar g.yab la: hūm̐: dbus nas rdo rje tshe yi lha: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: khyod kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: 'khor 'das tshe yi bcud rnams sdus: rdo rje'i tshe srog brtan par mdzod: phyogs bcu'i rdo rje tshe yi bdag: dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu: sprul pa'i phra men nyi shu'i tshogs: khyed kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phyogs skyong lag nas tshe khug la: rdo rje'i tshe srog brtan par mdzod: sras mchog sgo skyong srung ma'i tshogs: khyod kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: tshe srog gdon gyis brkus pa khug: rdo rje'i tshe mchog brtan par mdzod: tshe 'brang spyi bor bzhag la tshe chang 'thung: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa tshe yi lha: snying po ye shes bcud dang ldan: bde chen ye shes tshe stsol cig: rdo rje'i srog dang ldan par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe 'brang longs spyad bkra shis smon lam rnams bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ kho bo mchog gyur gling pas karma'i dam can brag nas spyan drangs pa'o//
